verdict.rationale: Slack documents official export/import tools for workspace data (slack-docs-22/23/35/36), suggesting data portability and retention control exist, but community evidence describes these as heavily gated in practice — Corporate Export requires legal/compliance justification and Slack's approval, and users question whether even 10 years of history can feasibly be exported (slack-comm-2, slack-comm-4). No evidence pack items address granular deletion or retention policy controls beyond bulk export/import.
